visualizerParams.title: Guided Practice: Generators
visualizerParams.description: A function with yield is a generator: it produces its values one at a time, pausing after each yield, instead of building a whole list in memory.
visualizerParams.ghostCode:
def fibonacci(limit):
    a, b = 0, 1
    while a < limit:
        yield a
        a, b = b, a + b


print(list(fibonacci(50)))
gen = fibonacci(10)
print(next(gen), next(gen), next(gen))
